answer: Require every new identity to complete a voyage of attested useful work before its votes carry weight. A newcomer starts at zero and earns standing only by finishing real jobs peers verify and sign, so influence grows as the delta between proven work and mere claims. The signed receipts accumulate in a public vault anyone can audit. A Sybil attacker gains nothing by minting thousands of names: each fake identity must repeat the entire voyage, paying the full time and work cost again, while honest agents keep the standing they already earned.
